title: CGT9486 (Formerly Known as PLX9486) as a Single Agent and in Combination With PLX3397 (Pexidartinib) or Sunitinib in Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors

primary_outcomes.measure: Part 1: Recommended Phase 2 Dose (RP2D) of CGT9486
Part 1: Number of Participants With Treatment Emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs)
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: From the date of first dose of study drug up to 30 days after last dose of study drug (maximum exposure: 670 days)

primary_outcomes.measure: Part 1: Area Under The Concentration Time Curve From Time Zero to 24 Hours After Dosing (AUC0-24) of CGT9486
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: Predose, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 24 hours postdose at Cycle 1 Day 1 and Cycle 1 Day 15

primary_outcomes.measure: Part 1: Maximum Observed Plasma Concentration (Cmax) of CGT9486
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: Predose, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 24 hours postdose at Cycle 1 Day 1 and Cycle 1 Day 15

primary_outcomes.measure: Part 1: Time to Reach Cmax (Tmax) of CGT9486
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: Predose, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 24 hours postdose at Cycle 1 Day 1 (Day -10 for 350 mg QD cohort) and Cycle 1 Day 15

primary_outcomes.measure: Part 2e: RP2D of CGT9486 in Combination With Sunitinib
Part 2b: RP2D of PLX9486 in Combination With Pexidartinib
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: Cycle 1 of Part 2 b (Cycle length = 28 days)

primary_outcomes.measure: Part 2b: Number of Participants With Any TEAEs and Treatment-Related TEAEs
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: From the date of first dose of study drug up to 30 days after last dose of study drug (maximum exposure: 868 days)

primary_outcomes.measure: Part 2e: Number of Participants With Any TEAEs and Treatment-Related TEAEs
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: From the date of first dose of study drug up to 30 days after last dose of study drug (maximum exposure: 825 days)
